title: Open Parties and Claims: Warfare
description: An unofficial warfare addon for OPaC with chunk wars, contested claims, raid windows, protection rules, Create support, Big Cannons protection, and Xaero war waypoints.
body:
# Open Parties and Claims: Warfare

**Open Parties and Claims: Warfare** is an unofficial server-side addon for **Open Parties and Claims**.

It adds chunk wars, contested claims, raid windows, configurable protection rules, Create machine control, Create Big Cannons protection, and optional Xaero war waypoints for NeoForge servers.

This mod does **not** replace Open Parties and Claims. OPaC remains the source of party membership and claim ownership; OPaC Warfare builds war and protection mechanics on top of existing OPaC territories.

## Features

* Chunk wars for OPaC party and personal claims
* Preparation and active war phases
* Contested chunks with capture progress
* Raid window support
* AFK defender checks
* Bossbar, actionbar, and war lives
* Configurable post-war protection
* Explosion protection for peaceful claims
* Storage breaking protection
* Wither and villager protection rules
* Create drill, saw, and contraption protection
* Create Big Cannons launch and terrain-damage protection
* Optional Xaero temporary war waypoints

## How wars work

Players can start a war for an enemy claimed chunk. If the target is valid, the war enters a preparation phase and then becomes active.

During an active war, the target chunk becomes contested. Attackers and defenders can fight for capture progress while outsiders do not get the contested bypass.

If attackers reach 100% capture progress, the claim is transferred to the attacking side. If the war is cancelled or fails, the original claim owner is restored.

## Protection rules

OPaC Warfare adds extra server-side rules for protected territories:

* block/place interaction limits for foreign players
* peaceful claim explosion filtering
* storage breaking protection
* Wither rules
* villager protection
* Create machine control
* Create Big Cannons projectile and terrain-damage protection

Protection rules can be managed through `/claimrules`.

## Commands

War commands:

```text
/war start
/war status
/war list
/war near
```

Admin war commands:

```text
/waradmin list
/waradmin stop here
/waradmin skipprep here
/waradmin setprogress here <value>
```

Claim rule commands:

```text
/claimrules explosions status
/claimrules explosions enable
/claimrules explosions disable
/claimrules create status
/claimrules create enable
/claimrules create disable
/claimrules gui
```

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* NeoForge 21.1.232+
* Java 21
* Open Parties and Claims 0.27.5+

## Optional integrations

OPaC Warfare can run without these mods, but enables extra features when they are installed:

* Create 6.0.9+
  Enables Create drill, saw, contraption movement, and claimed-block protection rules.

* Create Big Cannons 5.11.7+
  Enables protected-claim projectile launch blocking and terrain-damage protection.

* RPL 2.1.2+
  Required when using the Create Big Cannons integration, depending on your Create Big Cannons setup.

* Xaero's Minimap for Minecraft 1.21.1
  Enables temporary war waypoints for compatible clients.

* Xaero's World Map for Minecraft 1.21.1
  Optional support for Xaero-related war marker visibility.

Create, Create Big Cannons, RPL, Xaero's Minimap, and Xaero's World Map are optional. If they are not installed, OPaC Warfare will still run without those integrations.

## Installation

Install the single release jar:

```text
opac-warfare-<version>.jar
```

Do not install the separate `customclaims_*` module jars together with `opac-warfare`, because the single jar already contains all OPaC Warfare modules.

Required in `/mods`:

```text
opac-warfare-<version>.jar
open-parties-and-claims-<version>.jar
```

Optional:

```text
create-<version>.jar
create-big-cannons-<version>.jar
xaero-<version>.jar
```

## Version note

Version 1.6.1 is the first public Modrinth release of Open Parties and Claims: Warfare. Earlier versions were internal development builds.

Make backups before using this mod on a production server.
